title: Đây có phải là tổng số tiền?
pronunciation: Day co phai la tong so tien
summary: For confirming the full hotel charge before you pay, sign, or leave the desk.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Taxes, deposits, minibar charges, late checkout, or service fees may still be separate.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Point to the printed bill, booking screen, or card terminal so the answer is about the exact total.

phrases.vietnamese: Đây có phải là tổng số tiền?
phrases.pronunciation: Day co phai la tong so tien

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Đây có phải là asks is this; tổng số tiền means the total amount.

breakdown.vietnamese: Đây có phải là tổng số tiền?

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Deposit refund, unused charge, and emailed invoice phrases help when the hotel bill needs a closer look.

phrases.vietnamese: Bạn có thể gửi email cho tôi hóa đơn được không?

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at checkout, after a room change, before a card payment, or when a deposit line looks unclear.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: If the answer is not a clear yes, ask them to write the total before you tap or sign.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Write total, receipt, service charge, extra fee, and refund phrases cover the next money check.
